product.olivetti-m20-d.summary: The M20 offered with two floppy drives in the main unit.
product.olivetti-m20-d.history: The Centre for Computing History identifies its specimen as the M20 D and gives a UK price of £2,395 before VAT for the twin-floppy version.
product.olivetti-m20-d.architecture: The two drives let the console use two floppy disks. The CH49850 photograph shows both drives built into the console beside the keyboard.
product.olivetti-m20-d.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m20-d.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
